subject: Television & Streaming
title: International Format Sales
description: A short lesson to help you apply International Format Sales.

hook.text: The Office started in the UK. American Idol came from Britain's Pop Idol. Television's biggest hits are often imports.

twist.text: The concept of 'owning' a TV format is legally murky. Ideas can't be copyrighted, only specific expressions of them.

climax.text: Format licensing created a global television economy where the best ideas travel across borders, adapted for each.

punchline.text: Television's best export isn't shows—it's ideas.

quiz.question: What makes TV format licensing legally complicated?
options: Ideas can't be copyrighted, only specific expressions, making format clones common
